title: Uncle from Another World
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Takafumi's uncle wakes from a 17-year coma and reveals that he spent it in a fantasy world, where he can still use magic. Living with his nephew and helped by Takafumi's childhood friend Sumika, he adjusts to modern Japan while they watch his magically replayed memories, which show him repeatedly misreading the people who tried to befriend him.
life_message: Social awkwardness can hide real kindness, and family can make room for an odd person who never fit in.
